items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Barney and Whetsol and Metzel was playing the three things together... he did a concerto for Barney

ctx.x: After you were with Duke, what was the first composition you wrote?

Well, the first one was Caravan, which just happened to be -- we was at the Cotton Club here in Los Angeles, and Duke invited a famous director from MGM, the music director -- oh, I can never recall people's names -- but anyhow, he invited him to come to the Cotton Club, after we get through and they closed the place, and this group -- we were going to give him like a small concert or something. But before the concert, I used to go there in the front and play the band and play anything Spanish on my trombone, and…

So after the concert, we played everything; we played Concerto for Barney, Concerto for Cootie, concerto for so and so -- everyone -- he threw everything he had in the book at us, and he made me play Caravan, so I played Caravan, and when we finished with the concert -- we usually go for inter-
